core_obligations: Reduce the claim to the homotopy statement for S_bullet via the cosimplicial resolution criterion (proof lines 458-465).
Write Q = A[E] and rewrite S_bullet as the mapping simplicial set Mor_Sets((E, beta|_E), (P_bullet, epsilon)) (proof lines 466-470).
Introduce the fibre F_{b,bullet} of epsilon over b and express S_bullet as the product of the F_{beta(e),bullet} (proof lines 471-480).
Apply base change and product stability of trivial Kan fibrations, then the homotopy criterion, to conclude (proof lines 481-487).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a simplicial A-algebra P_bullet augmented over B whose terms are polynomial algebras and whose augmentation is a trivial Kan fibration on underlying simplicial sets, one has Lpi_!(F) = F(P_bullet, epsilon) in D(Ab) resp. D(B), functorially in F (source lines 445-456). The proof invokes the cosimplicial resolution criterion of Cohomology on Sites: for an object U = (Q, beta) of the category C it must show that the simplicial set S_bullet = Mor_C((P_bullet, epsilon), (Q, beta)) is homotopy equivalent to a point; writing Q = A[E] it rewrites S_bullet as a product over E of the fibres F_{b,bullet} of epsilon over the images beta(e), each of which is a trivial Kan fibration by base change, so the product and then S_bullet itself are trivial Kan fibrations and hence homotopy equivalent to a point.
